overview_description.description: Transpooler is a school bus transportation management solution for managing an outsourced fleet. It offers a web-based school bus tracking system and a corresponding mobile app for parents. It has features that include real-time tracking, speeding alerts, driver-parent communications, automated ETA notifications and alerts, in-bus attendance, and more. Additionally, the company also offers a developer API. Its mobile apps for drivers and parents are available for iOS and Android platforms.
